# SameDayDesk

> SameDayDesk is a same-day, done-for-you research, data, code, automation, and AI-search visibility desk. Services have flat prices, a free revision, and a money-back guarantee. Code and data work runs or it is free.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://samedaydesk.com/): Service catalog, prices, guarantee, and order links.
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://samedaydesk.com/ai-visibility-audit.html): Citation testing, competitor benchmarking, and prioritized fixes from $199.
- [Free AI Readiness Checker](https://samedaydesk.com/tools/ai-readiness): Check crawler access, metadata, structured data, sitemap, and llms.txt.
- [Resources](https://samedaydesk.com/resources.html): Original research, practical guides, and free AI-search tools.

## Agent interfaces

- [Remote MCP server](https://samedaydesk.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP interface for the AI-readiness checker.
- [x402 data gateway](https://samedaydesk.com/x402): Seven pay-per-call MCP tools, prices, source, and connection instructions.
- [x402 SDK integration reference](https://samedaydesk.com/docs/x402-sdk/): Sourcey-generated Go API reference plus production integration notes for the SDK family used by the live gateway.
- [x402 data gateway on Smithery](https://smithery.ai/servers/epistemedeus/x402-data-gateway): Managed MCP connection and seven published tool schemas.
- [x402 service health](https://x402-url-extractor-production.up.railway.app/healthz): Live health and pricing for the SameDayDesk agent data gateway.
- [x402 resource manifest](https://x402-url-extractor-production.up.railway.app/.well-known/x402): Machine-readable paid resources on Base mainnet using USDC.
- [x402 gateway llms.txt](https://x402-url-extractor-production.up.railway.app/llms.txt): Endpoint descriptions and payment instructions.

## Public work

- [OpenScan documentation case study](https://samedaydesk.com/docs-lab/openscan/): Durable, source-backed documentation created from a real open-source project.
- [GopherJS API documentation case study](https://samedaydesk.com/docs-lab/gopherjs/): Searchable Sourcey reference for 17 packages and 197 exports, generated from pinned GopherJS source with an open upstream adoption PR.
- [Solana Ecosystem Pulse](https://samedaydesk.com/data-lab/solana-pulse/): Public-data dashboard with synchronized JSON, Markdown, and interactive HTML outputs.
- [AI Search Readiness Leaderboard](https://samedaydesk.com/reports/ai-search-readiness-leaderboard-2026.html): Original benchmark of 189 companies across 10 industries.
